async def act(page):
    # Hover over the Catalog link to expand its menu
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog").hover()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the Products link in the expanded menu
    await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Products").click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
